item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya is measuring the temperature of warm water in a steel vessel at home using a laboratory thermometer.
Which method will give her the correct reading?

options.A: Dip the bulb fully in the water without touching the vessel, hold the thermometer upright, and read at eye level while the bulb is still in the water once the column stops rising.
options.B: Dip the bulb fully in the water, take the thermometer out of the water, and then read the column at eye level.
options.C: Rest the bulb on the bottom of the vessel so the thermometer stays steady, and read the column at eye level.
options.D: Dip only the tip of the bulb in the water and read the column quickly before it can change.
